business_model.basis: Stated in the 10-K Item 1 for the fiscal year ended 2025-09-30.
business_model.claim: Cabot is a global specialty chemicals and performance materials company that reports in two segments, Reinforcement Materials and Performance Chemicals.
quotes: Our business is currently organized into two reportable segments: Reinforcement Materials and Performance Chemicals.

business_model.claim: Reinforcement Materials sells reinforcing carbons (carbon black) used in tires and industrial products such as hoses and belts. It also sells engineered elastomer composites (E2C), which are rubber-and-carbon composites for tires and high-wear rubber products.
quotes: Our reinforcing carbons products are used in tires and industrial products.

business_model.basis: Stated in the 10-K Item 1 and Item 1A.
business_model.claim: Reinforcement Materials depends on a small group of large tire customers. About sixty percent of reinforcing carbons volume is sold under supply arrangements, typically one year long, that adjust prices for feedstock and other cost changes.
quotes: Sales to five major tire customers represent a material portion of Reinforcement Materials
These arrangements typically provide for sales price adjustments to account for changes in relevant feedstock costs including natural gas

business_model.claim: Performance Chemicals combines specialty carbons, specialty compounds, battery materials, fumed metal oxides, aerogel and inkjet product lines. It serves automotive, construction, electronics, inkjet printing, consumer products and energy-storage end uses.
quotes: In this reporting segment we combine our specialty carbons, specialty compounds, battery materials, fumed metal oxides, aerogel and inkjet product lines.

business_model.claim: Some Performance Chemicals lines are concentrated in a few customers. Four customers account for approximately 50% of battery materials revenue, and six customers under contract account for about one-third of fumed metal oxides revenue.
quotes: In our battery materials product line, sales to four customers account for approximately 50% of revenue.

Segment profit has shifted between the segments. Fiscal 2026 segment EBIT was $379 million for Reinforcement Materials, down from 508 (table in millions), and $235 million for Performance Chemicals, up from 194 (table in millions).
quotes: Performance Chemicals segment EBIT of $235 million and Reinforcement Materials segment EBIT of $379 million
